properties.name: Bheem Nagar Shelter
properties.notes: Address given as 'Allipuram, Railway Station Road'. Geocoded (Photon/OSM, Nominatim was blocked in this environment) to the Allipuram neighbourhood centroid, ~430m from Visakhapatnam Railway Station, consistent with the 'Railway Station Road' landmark; not the specific building.

properties.name: TSR Complex Men Shelter
properties.notes: Address given as 'Dwaraka Nagar, Railway Station Road'. Geocoded directly to 'TSR building complex' (OSM POI, Dwaraka Nagar), a name-exact match. Independently corroborated by a separate GVMC/AUTD shelter listing (Justdial) citing 'VRC Complex, Dwaraka Nagar, Railway Station Road, Opp. TSR Complex' ~180m away.

properties.name: TSR Complex Women Shelter
properties.notes: Co-located with the men's wing at the same TSR Complex address (Dwaraka Nagar, Railway Station Road) per source; same coordinates used. See TSR Complex Men Shelter notes for geocode basis.

properties.name: Maharanipeta Shelter
properties.notes: Address given as 'Beside Collector Office'. Geocoded directly to the Visakhapatnam District Collector Office (OSM POI), matching the address's landmark exactly.

properties.name: Peda Waltair Shelter
properties.notes: Address given as 'Dalai Vari Peta' (a sub-locality of Peda Waltair). Resolved to the Pedda Waltair locality centroid (OSM); the specific Dalai Vari Peta site was not separately resolvable.

properties.name: Bhupesh Nagar Shelter
properties.notes: Address given as 'Chavula Madum, Beside Railway Station'. Neither 'Bhupesh Nagar' nor 'Chavula Madum' resolved as a named OSM locality; placed at Visakhapatnam Railway Station, matching the address's 'Beside Railway Station' landmark. Not the specific site.

properties.name: Butchi Raju Palem Shelter
properties.notes: Address given as 'Near NAD Kotha Road'. Geocoded to a named Butchirajupalem POI (OSM) ~250-500m from both 'NAD Junction' and a 'NAD Kotha Road' bus stop (OSM), corroborating the address landmark. CONFLICT FLAGGED: a separate listing (Mappls) ties a 'Night Shelter for Urban Homeless' at Butchirajupalem to GVMC Ward No. 67, but this repo's wards.geojson Ward 67 polygon centroid lies ~6.4km away and does not contain this point -- the ward-number attribution looks stale or mismatched (possible ward renumbering/delimitation change) and was NOT used for placement; the independently corroborated street-level geocode was used instead.

properties.name: Arilova Shelter
properties.notes: Source gives no street address, only the locality name 'Arilova'. Placed at the Arilova neighbourhood centroid (OSM); several nearby OSM points (Arilova Colony, Arilova Main Road) cluster within ~1km, consistent with this placement.
